title: Universal Business Model Engine
principles: MikroORM is persistence foundation; UBME owns business-model semantics.
Compile model/addon metadata before MikroORM initialization and freeze the registry.
Use explicit ExecutionContext and per-request/per-job EntityManager forks.
Use typed domain AST and deny-by-default authorization.
Review production migrations; never auto-sync production schema.
Prove Bun SQLite and PostgreSQL compatibility with full adapter contract tests.

phases.name: Feasibility and architecture lock
phases.goal: Prove Bun + MikroORM + SQLite + PostgreSQL support and freeze persistence approach.
tasks: Pin exact Bun and aligned MikroORM package versions in a spike branch.
Prototype EntitySchema/defineEntity compilation before ORM init.
Prove bun:sqlite using SqliteDriver + Kysely + kysely-bun-sqlite.
Prove PostgreSQL using MikroORM PostgreSQL driver and pg under Bun.
Test relations, Unit of Work, rollback, migrations, concurrency, shutdown.
Record OS/architecture/package matrix and document blockers.
acceptance: SQLite contract suite passes under Bun.
PostgreSQL contract suite passes or an explicit alternative runtime decision is approved.
Compatibility report includes exact versions and reproducible commands.
No unverified support claims remain.

phases.name: Core contracts and registry
phases.goal: Build deterministic metadata registry without database dependency.
tasks: Define ModelDefinition, FieldDefinition, RelationDefinition, ActionDefinition and PolicyDefinition.
Implement BUILDING/FROZEN registry states.
Implement naming, duplicate and relation target validation.
Implement addon dependency sorting and cycle detection.
Build immutable metadata snapshot and typed errors.
acceptance: Registry tests pass without database.
Invalid and cyclic definitions fail deterministically.
Frozen registry rejects mutation.

phases.name: Persistence compiler and context
phases.goal: Compile basic model metadata and provide isolated persistence contexts.
tasks: Compile scalar UBME fields into MikroORM metadata.
Implement MikroORM composition root and adapter lifecycle.
Implement explicit ExecutionContext and EntityManager forks.
Implement codecs for UUID, Decimal, Date, DateTime, JSON and Boolean.
Implement scalar CRUD, flush, transaction and rollback.
acceptance: CRUD works on all supported adapters.
Concurrent contexts have isolated identity maps.
Rollback leaves no partial state.

phases.name: Relations and domain query
phases.goal: Implement safe relationships and portable query AST.
tasks: Implement ManyToOne, OneToMany, OneToOne and ManyToMany.
Add explicit association entity support.
Implement typed domain AST parser and field/operator validation.
Compile parameterized search predicates.
Implement count, exists, stable sorting and pagination.
Add explicit population plans and query complexity limits.
acceptance: Relation and referential integrity tests pass.
Invalid user query is rejected before SQL execution.
Count/search/exists share query-scope enforcement.

phases.name: Security boundary
phases.goal: Ensure model, record, field and tenant rules cannot be bypassed by public operations.
tasks: Implement model ACL and named action permissions.
Implement deny-by-default record grant/deny policy composition.
Inject tenant/org constraints into every query path.
Implement field-level read/write and serialization policies.
Secure aggregates, relation traversal, exports and bulk operations.
Restrict raw EntityManager and QueryBuilder to adapter internals.
Add PostgreSQL RLS defense-in-depth where appropriate.
acceptance: All security threat tests pass.
Tenant isolation passes on every supported adapter.
No application path can bypass the UBME policy boundary.

phases.name: RecordSet, actions, validation and events
phases.goal: Deliver an Odoo-inspired batch model API and transactional business operations.
tasks: Implement RecordSet browse/search/read/write/unlink/count/exists.
Implement field/model validation and database constraint mapping.
Implement action registration, input schemas and transaction policies.
Implement optimistic version conflict handling.
Map lifecycle hooks with collection-change tests.
Implement transactional outbox and idempotent dispatcher contract.
Add audited system capabilities.
acceptance: SaleOrder vertical slice confirms/cancels through actions.
Action failure rolls back domain and outbox rows.
Bulk APIs cannot skip policies or invariants.
Concurrent update yields a conflict instead of silent overwrite.

phases.name: Compute engine
phases.goal: Implement deterministic virtual and then safely stored computed fields.
tasks: Build compute dependency graph and cycle detection.
Implement virtual compute for explicit projections.
Implement same-record scalar dependency recomputation.
Add relation-aware invalidation only after full mutation matrix is covered.
Add batched stored compute/backfill jobs.
Declare search/sort/group support per computed field.
acceptance: All supported dependency changes recompute correctly.
Rollback and bulk updates leave no stale stored value.
Unsupported patterns fail explicitly.

phases.name: Model extension and addons
tasks: Implement mixins and abstract mapped metadata.
Implement model extension with collision and override rules.
Implement delegation/composition metadata.
Evaluate STI only for concrete use case.
Implement addon manifests and dependency version checks.
Implement addon migration/install plan.
Freeze model registry before ORM init.
acceptance: Addon graph is deterministic.
Incompatible field collisions fail.
Existing table changes require explicit migration/backfill.

phases.name: CLI, migrations and operations
phases.goal: Make schema evolution and production operations safe and inspectable.
tasks: Implement model:list, model:describe and addon:graph.
Implement schema:check and migration diff workflow.
Implement migration status/apply wrapper.
Add migration preflight and backup/restore hooks.
Add structured logs, query metrics, readiness and compatibility report.
Write deployment and upgrade runbooks.
acceptance: Previous-release fixtures upgrade successfully.
Boot fails on incompatible schema.
Production schema is never automatically synchronized.

phases.name: Hardening and v1 release
phases.goal: Validate correctness, security, portability and operational readiness.
tasks: Run performance baselines and inspect query plans.
Add N+1/query budget and fuzz tests.
Run load and concurrency tests including SQLite lock contention.
Test worker retries, idempotency and graceful shutdown.
Audit exports, dependency graph and persistence bypasses.
Complete docs, examples, compatibility matrix and release notes.
acceptance: All v1 gates in BLUEPRINT.md pass.
Supported runtime/database matrix is published.
Clean checkout builds and reproduces all tests.
